name: rocket-ai-shield
description: Reduces tokens in prompts sent to GitHub Copilot via smart context compression.

commands.title: Rocket - IPG: Optimize Active File Context
Rocket - IPG: Optimize Active File (Full Context Demo)
Rocket - IPG: Show Last Reduction Report

chatParticipants.name: rocket-optimize
chatParticipants.description: Reduces context tokens before sending your question to the model.

rocketToken.maxInputTokens.description: Maximum input tokens to send to the model.

rocketToken.contextFocusThresholdPercent.description: Run context focusing when token usage exceeds this % of budget.

rocketToken.enableCompression.description: Enable deep compression as final fallback.

rocketToken.contextFocusTimeoutMs.description: Max time in ms allowed for context focusing before fallback.

rocketToken.compressionTimeoutMs.description: Max time in ms allowed for compression before truncation fallback.

rocketToken.costPer1kTokens.description: Estimated cost per 1,000 tokens in USD. Set this to your model's actual input token price to see accurate credit savings in the dashboard.

scripts.clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path out) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force out }; Get-ChildItem src -Recurse -Include *.js,*.js.map | Remove-Item -Force"
